This example uses a `Pango::FontMap` as its model.
This is possible because `Pango::FontMap` implements
the `Gio::ListModel` interface. Of course you can use a
`FontDialogButton` instead.
blocks.zh: 该示例用 `Pango::FontMap` 作为模型——这可行，因为 `Pango::FontMap` 实现了 `Gio::ListModel` 接口。当然，你也可以改用 `FontDialogButton`。
